title: Demetri Papadimitropoulos: 'Values Do Not Endure Because People Say Them Fervently. They Endure When Power Has Been Designed to Remember Them.'
summary: Goodreads reviewer Demetri Papadimitropoulos publishes a deeply analytical 4-star review of Incorruptible — accompanied by a series of original watercolor studies titled 'After the Vote' — calling it 'far more alive than a book about corporate governance has any polite obligation to be.'
blockquote: Values do not endure because people say them fervently. They endure when power has been designed to remember them after fervor fades.
